name: tidepool
description: A hackable desktop MCP client with a Claude chat interface and MCP Apps support
author: Amit Varia

scripts.dev: npm run build:speech && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-vite dev --watch
scripts.test:e2e: electron-vite build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE node tests/e2e.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:all: electron-vite build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE sh -c 'node tests/e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e-webmcp.mjs && node tests/e2e-assistant.mjs && node tests/e2e-shortcuts.mjs && node tests/e2e-import.mjs && node tests/e2e-browse.mjs && node tests/e2e-oauth.mjs && node tests/e2e-skills.mjs && node tests/e2e-pinned.mjs'
